**A**: The Fansly Downloader executables are not digitally signature signed, as it comes with continous prohibitively expensive costs. So the executables tend to produce alot of false positives (invalid detections). Instead each release of the scraper is e-mailed to antivirus providers for manual analysis, and the not 💩 providers actually analyse and unflag them, while others don't even bother reading their e-mails, but for some reason managed to get on VirusTotals file scanning system. If you're knowledgeable with the python programming language; any pyinstaller compiled python executable, such as Fansly Downloader, is de-compileable with e.g. uncompyle6, so you could additionally assure yourself that no harmful code is being distributed to your local machine.
